---
title: "bgmCompare"
---

Compare graphical models between groups.

## Description

`bgmCompare()` tests for differences in network structure between independent 
groups using Bayes factor tests.

## Usage

```r
bgmCompare(
  x,
  group,
  ...
)
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `x` | A data frame or matrix of observations. |
| `group` | A factor or vector indicating group membership. |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to the sampler. |

## Value

An object of class `bgmCompare` containing posterior samples and Bayes factors 
for group differences.

## Examples

```{r}
#| eval: false

# Simulated example
```
